result.summary: This PR reworks the make_hard_case helper and the BnBExhaustion benchmark in src/bench/coin_selection.cpp so the benchmark reliably exhausts the branch-and-bound search's 100,000-attempt limit and asserts that a solution was actually found. The author tuned target and UTXO values and the cost_of_change parameter to sit at the threshold that causes exhaustion, replacing an earlier setup that used unrealistically large amounts.
result.problem: The previous benchmark used contrived, unrealistically large coin values that gave a misleading impression of what triggers BnB exhaustion, and lacked assertions verifying the benchmark actually behaves as intended (exhausting the search and finding a solution). This affects developers relying on the benchmark to reason about coin-selection performance.

resolved_concerns: Initial version used a target of 800,000 sats which gave a false impression of what's needed to exhaust the search; author revised to more realistic amounts after review discussion.
